name: Huanglong Scenic and Historic Interest Area
description: Huanglong, or "Yellow Dragon," is a mountain valley in northwest Sichuan, about 370 km north-northwest of Chengdu. Its star attraction is a winding gully of terraced pools tinted turquoise, blue and gold by calcite deposits. Above them rise snow-capped peaks and the easternmost glacier in China, while forests nearby shelter giant pandas and golden snub-nosed monkeys. Waterfalls and hot springs add to the scenery.
